basic_info.description: Discover unparalleled living at One Rincon Hill in this sleek and modern 2-bedroom, 2-bathroom condo, perched high above San Francisco's iconic skyline. This sophisticated, light-filled unit features the coveted 06 floor plan, offering stunning daytime views of the city and Twin Peaks, and breathtaking, shimmering skyline vistas at night. The condo boasts a split floor plan with expansive living spaces and elegant hardwood floors throughout, setting it apart from neighboring units. Unit 1506 is enhanced with an impressive developer 2B upgrade finish package. Residents are treated to a wealth of luxury amenities, including a 24-hour doorman, concierge services, and full-service valet parking. The club-quality fitness center includes steam rooms and showers, while the outdoor space features a full-size pool, a beautifully landscaped garden deck, a large open grass area, and a gourmet barbecue space. In addition, One Rincon Hill residents enjoy exclusive access to The Harrison's premium amenities, such as Uncle Harry's Penthouse Lounge and a Professional Fitness Center.
